title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
lineage: SBD (unknown lineage)> SHN; Patch Source: AUD/FOB> CM> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Spectrum show with a smoking Shakedown Street, but the soundboard suffers from saturation and distortion.
ai_review.review: The concert is widely praised for its blistering second set – Shakedown Street, Lost Sailor / Saint of Circumstance, Terrapin Part 1 and an epic The Other One intro are repeatedly called “the best ever”.  The recording is a sound‑board source that many listeners find overly hot, with noticeable saturation, distortion on loud passages and occasional clicks, yet it remains listenable enough to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (over 30) rate the show 4‑5 stars and highlight exceptional musical moments, while recording complaints lower the technical score; weighted average yields ~4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Saturated sound with distortion on louder material, hot recording levels causing clipping, occasional clicks/pops and a few pitch‑related complaints; overall listenable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener (Cold Rain & Snow), tight first set, second set builds to a fire‑storm with Shakedown Street and The Other One; pacing keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for funkier playing on Shakedown Street and for his personal talk during Terrapin; guitar tone noted as “right on”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as soaring with “Phil swooping down” and delivering powerful bass lines that drive the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboard) highlighted as “killing it” with every part, adding to the fire of the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums and space sections noted for moving the audience and having fun; occasional high‑energy bursts.
